name: Frame Interpolation
description: Makes a video smoother by drawing new frames between the ones it has, with ComfyUI's own RIFE / FILM nodes. The result plays at the source's speed with multiplier times the frames, and keeps its sound.

params.label: Multiplier
params.description: How many frames come out for each one that goes in: 2 turns 24 fps into 48. The output frame rate follows, so the length stays the same.

params.label: Model
params.description: A RIFE 4.25 or 4.26 checkpoint (a raw `flownet.pkl` loads as-is), or a FILM one, in `frame_interpolation/`. Older RIFE versions (4.6, 4.9, 4.22) are a different shape and ComfyUI's loader refuses them.
